name: Bernadette Lourdes Suarez
office: City of Lawndale, Member of the City Council

items.text: Bernadette Lourdes Suarez is a member of the Lawndale City Council, with her current term expiring in November 2026. She was the city clerk before joining the council.

sentences.text: Bernadette Lourdes Suarez is a member of the Lawndale City Council, with her current term expiring in November 2026.
She was the city clerk before joining the council.

items.text: She serves on the board of directors for the South Bay Cities Council of Governments and on the board of Centinela Youth Services. She chairs the Homeless Services Task Force for the South Bay Cities Council of Governments. When running for the council in 2018, her campaign focused on public safety, maintaining a balanced city budget, and supporting small business.
